mainEntity.name: When should a small business consider investing in GEO services?

acceptedAnswer.text: A small business should consider investing in GEO services if its customer base is primarily local or if it has a physical storefront. This is particularly true if your business relies on foot traffic, local calls, or serves a specific community. If you're struggling to appear in local search results or want to attract more nearby customers, it's an opportune time to implement a GEO strategy.
